title: Larry Hancock: UAP at nuclear facilities 1949-1953, then stopped
summary: Steven Bruel tells of Larry Hancock: UAP at nuclear facilities 1949-1953, then stopped, about 1949-1953 at US nuclear facilities, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And what they found was high levels of activity from 1949 until 1953, and then it just stopped.

plain: On podcast host Jesse Michels's show, in an episode with astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, a guest named Steven Bruel points to an article by researcher Larry Hancock, written for a group that studies unexplained aerial sightings. Bruel says Hancock found high levels of strange objects, which officials now call UAP or unidentified anomalous phenomena, around US nuclear sites from 1949 until 1953, and then the activity just stopped. If true, it would suggest something was paying close attention to America's early nuclear work.
